The 100% DeepFluoro sacrum number is not the manuscript's method. It is a same-device detector (five specimens' real frames in training) initialised from a render-only model whose renders were 44.8% under the test specimen's own poses and whose device terms were fitted on its real pixels. The clean render-only number for that specimen is 88.5–91.3% at conf 0.05 (three seeds). The manuscript's 76.9% belongs to the anchor_none_r2 generation; the v2 generation every real fine-tune started from pools to 64.0%.

Position prior. A fixed box (the training set's median sacrum box) hits the truth sacrum at IoU ≥ 0.5 on 85.7% of C-ArmLSpine test frames (median IoU 0.69), 58.5% of COBRA and 13.5% of DeepFluoro. Surgeons centre the field the same way every time. "Sacrum found" on C-ArmLSpine is therefore partly a statement about layout; vertebra recall and level accuracy are not, and DeepFluoro's sacrum numbers cannot be explained this way.

Re-scored 06:50 EDT: the 5.2% was a box convention. Under the matched convention the C-ArmLSpine-held-out vertebra recall is 90.6%. C-ArmLSpine truth boxes are SPINEPS vertebral-body boxes; COBRA and DeepFluoro truth are whole-vertebra outlines. The C-ArmLSpine metas carry both, so the same predictions were re-scored (tools/or_lodo_rescore_outline.py, whole test frames, 287 vertebrae): body IoU 0.5 → 5.2%; outline IoU 0.5 → 90.6% at conf 0.25 (92.7% best); mutual-centre rule (convention-free) → 90.9%. The control behaves as predicted: the same-device pooled arm falls from 90.6% (body) to 40.8% (outline) and stays at 91.6% under the centre rule. The render-only detector reads 31.7% outline / 54.7% centre. So a detector that never saw this C-arm finds 91% of its vertebrae and 84% of its sacra on whole frames. The 3- and 1-vertebra crop cells are being re-scored the same way (their outline boxes had been left in parent-frame coordinates).

The crops are upscaled windows, so a detector that never saw this device's frames at that scale loses most of them, while the same-device control keeps 82%. Scale is a device-transfer lever of its own, separate from noise and display.

§7b

The detector fine-tuned on C-ArmLSpine alone boxes the phantom's vertebrae on three of the five well-populated machines; the three-device pooled detector, which scores 90–98% on its own devices, mostly does not. A sawbone with beads is not a patient, and without truth this is a sheet to look at, not a number to quote. Truth needs a threshold segmentation of the phantom CT (the 150 HU fallback kept one 8 ml blob) projected through the scenario poses the dataset ships.

Styled frames are not yet statistically inside the real domain (plan box C6). Real-vs-styled distances on the Cios card: NPS 0.111 against a real-vs-real floor of 0.015; grey histogram 3.1 vs 0.14; gradient 0.47 vs 0.11; unsharp halo gain 0.23 vs 0.16 (close). On the Pulsera card NPS 0.20 vs 0.04. The per-frame photon estimates span three decades and the sampler reproduced that spread, so draws paired pure grain with pure smear; draws are now clipped to the central quantile band and a term sweep is measuring which knob closes the gap. Until this box passes, the claim that physics-styled synthetic frames match real ones is not made.

The dataset census (101-agent verified search, docs/research_carm_datasets_verified_2026-09-22.json) corrected COBRA2026 to six centres and 867 patients (692 public), of which centres F–G are Varian kV imagers — a second linac device family; it added the Ljubljana angiographic set (10 patients, 3-D DSA + posed frames) and struck three candidates that ship no frames. None of the verified sets ships DICOM with vendor private tags. The RSNA AI endpoint and its checklist are in docs/RSNAI_PLAN.md.

§9

What the evidence supports, and what it does not

Supported

  • On the device it was trained on, level naming on real OR laterals is at 98% whole-frame and 93% with three vertebrae in view, cross-validated, with truth independent of the model and no leakage found.
  • The pipeline degrades gracefully: quantum noise to 300 photons, read noise to σ 0.06, ±15° rotation, any gamma, magnification, obliquity, collimation, shutter or instrument in the tested range cost under 10% of sacrum recall.
  • A level model that never saw a device names 89–90% of COBRA lateral levels exactly; sacrum-anchored counting reaches 80–84% on a held-out device. Both beat their fine-tuned counterparts.
  • Thoracic detection on real radiographs is at counting grade per level (97–99%) with a real-film keypoint detector.

Not supported yet

  • Counting-grade (≥97%) detection on a device held out entirely: best clean numbers are 84% sacrum / 91% vertebrae (C-ArmLSpine), 88–91% sacrum (DeepFluoro render-only, three seeds), 18–50% (COBRA), 32% (image intensifier).
  • Held-out recall on the 3- and 1-vertebra crops (the OR field): re-score pending; the body-box numbers (39.9% / 18.3% at conf 0.05) carry the same convention gap.
  • C2 on real images, in any arm.
  • The per-device parametric styling claim: no device has been fitted beyond the Cios Fusion, and no styled corpus exists.
